events.title: Iran War Escalation
events.summary: The ongoing conflict between the US and Iran continues to escalate, with potential for further military action. This could lead to increased volatility in oil prices and the stock market. The US has shown military strength, but also its waning geopolitical power.
events.reasoning: The conflict in Iran has the potential to disrupt global oil supplies, leading to increased prices and volatility. This could lead to a surge in demand for oil services, benefiting the VanEck Vectors Oil Services ETF (OIH). On the other hand, the US aerospace and defense sector may be negatively impacted by the waning geopolitical power of the US.

timeFrame.note: Monitor for a potential ceasefire or de-escalation

events.exitStrategy: Exit when a ceasefire is announced or oil prices stabilize

events.title: Fed Holds Interest Rates Steady
events.summary: The Federal Reserve has decided to hold interest rates steady, citing elevated inflation. This decision has been met with a mixed reaction from the market, with some investors expecting a rate hike.

actions.label: BUY
actions.target: iShares Core U.S. Aggregate Bond ETF (AGG)

events.reasoning: The decision to hold interest rates steady may lead to a decrease in bond yields, benefiting the iShares Core U.S. Aggregate Bond ETF (AGG). On the other hand, the lack of a rate hike may negatively impact the stock market, particularly the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust (SPY).
events.exitStrategy: Exit when the next Fed meeting takes place

events.title: NVIDIA AI Semiconductor Stocks
events.summary: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang has stated that the semiconductor industry could grow to $7.9 trillion to support the agentic AI boom. This has led to increased interest in AI-powered stocks, particularly those related to semiconductors.
events.reasoning: The potential growth of the semiconductor industry, driven by the agentic AI boom, makes NVIDIA Corporation (NVDA) and Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (AMD) attractive buys. These companies are well-positioned to benefit from the increased demand for AI-powered semiconductors.

gains.extendedNote: If the semiconductor industry experiences rapid growth
